description_en: Detects whether a face in an image is from a real person by using the API operation. This service combines the Qwen-VL large model for in-depth forgery risk detection to determine face liveness
description_zh: 指通过API接口传入提前获取的人脸图片进行真实人脸检测的服务，结合Qwen-VL大模型深入检测伪造风险，判断是否为真人
name: FaceLivenessV2

parameters.help_en: The product plan to use. Valid values: FACE_LIVENESS_MIN_PRO and FACE_LIVENESS_MIN
parameters.help_zh: 要接入的产品方案。取值FACE_LIVENESS_MIN_PRO / FACE_LIVENESS_MIN
parameters.name: product_code

parameters.help_en: The merchant-defined unique business ID for subsequent troubleshooting. The value can be a combination of letters and digits with a maximum length of 32 characters. Make sure the value is unique
parameters.help_zh: 商户侧自定义的业务唯一标识，用于后续定位排查问题使用。支持字母和数字的组合，长度最长32位，请确保唯一
parameters.name: merchant_biz_id

parameters.help_en: The custom user ID or another identifier that can identify a specific user, such as a phone number or email address. We strongly recommend that you desensitize the value of this field in advance, for example, by hashing the value
parameters.help_zh: 您自定义的用户ID，或者其他可以识别特定用户的标识，例如：手机号码、邮箱地址等。强烈建议对该字段的值进行预先脱敏，例如对值进行哈希处理
parameters.name: merchant_user_id

parameters.help_en:
The Base64-encoded face image.

Note

If you use this method to pass in the image, check the image size and do not pass in an excessively large image.
Specify one of the following parameters: FacePictureBase64, FacePictureUrl, or FacePictureFile
parameters.help_zh:
人像图片 Base64 编码。

说明

如果您选择该方式传入证件图片，请检查照片大小，不要传入过大的照片。
FacePictureBase64 和 FacePictureUrl 和 FacePictureFile 三选一
parameters.name: face_picture_base64

parameters.help_en: The URL of the face image. The URL must be a publicly accessible HTTPS URL
parameters.help_zh: 人脸照片地址。公网可访问的HTTPS链接
parameters.name: face_picture_url

parameters.help_en: The file stream of the face image
parameters.name: face_picture_file

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to check the quality of the face image. Valid values:
Y: enabled.
N: disabled. This is the default value
parameters.help_zh:
是否检测人脸图片质量
Y：开启
N：关闭（默认）
parameters.name: face_quality_check

FaceAge.description_en: The predicted reference age of the face. The prediction may fail and return no value
FaceAge.description_zh: 人脸预测的参考年龄，可能存在预测失败无结果值的情况

FaceAttack.description_en: The liveness detection result. Valid values: Y (attack detected) and N (Normal)
FaceAttack.description_zh: 活体检测结果，Y（攻击）/N（正常）

FaceGender.description_en:
The predicted gender of the face image. The prediction may fail and return no value. Valid values:

M: male.
F: female
FaceGender.description_zh:
人脸图片预测的性别，可能存在预测失败无结果值的情况。

M：男
F：女

FaceQualityScore.description_en: The quality score of the liveness face. Valid values: 0 to 100. A higher value indicates better quality
FaceQualityScore.description_zh: 活体人脸质量分数。取值范围0～100，数值越大质量越好

IlluminationScore.description_en: The algorithm score for illumination, which is a sub-dimension of quality assessment. Valid values: 0 to 100. A higher value indicates better quality
IlluminationScore.description_zh: 质量判断子维度，光照的算法分数，取值范围0～100，数值越大质量越好

KaOcclusionScore.description_en: The algorithm score for key area occlusion, which is a sub-dimension of quality assessment. Valid values: 0 to 100. A higher value indicates better quality
KaOcclusionScore.description_zh: 质量判断子维度，关键区域遮挡的算法分数，取值范围0～100，数值越大质量越好

OcclusionResult.description_en: Indicates whether facial occlusion is detected. A value of Y indicates occlusion is detected. A value of N indicates no occlusion is detected
OcclusionResult.description_zh: 有脸部遮挡，有脸部遮挡为Y，否则为N

OcclusionScore.description_en: The algorithm score for occlusion, which is a sub-dimension of quality assessment. Valid values: 0 to 100. A higher value indicates better quality
OcclusionScore.description_zh: 质量判断子维度，遮挡的算法分数，取值范围0～100，数值越大质量越好

SharpnessScore.description_en: The image sharpness score, which is a sub-dimension of quality assessment. Valid values: 0 to 100. A higher value indicates better quality
SharpnessScore.description_zh: 质量判断子维度，图片清晰度分数，取值范围0～100，数值越大质量越好

Passed.description_en:
Indicates whether the authentication is passed. Valid values:

Y: Passed.
N: Not passed
Passed.description_zh:
认证是否通过。

Y：通过。
N：不通过

TransactionId.description_en: The unique ID of the authentication request
